summary: Run post-write readback confirmation only for ASCET components or projects.
routingHints: Use verify only after a live write when you need structured readback confirmation of what ASCET now contains.

Readback execution semantics are inherited from the routed summary command: object-specific readback routes (AscetReadClassSummary, AscetReadModuleSummary, AscetReadStateMachineSummary, AscetReadProjectFormulas) are legacy one-shot with hostEligible=false, while the generic fallback via AscetReadComponentSummary inherits pooled_read with hostEligible=true.
Do not position verify as a general summary browser or a general diagnostic shell.
